raw:
Based on the race reports I retrieved, Fisichella won one Grand Prix while driving for Jordan: the 2003 Brazilian Grand Prix, where he started 8th and finished first. The other Jordan results I found were a 6th-place finish at the 2002 Canadian GP (his other 2002 Jordan result was an engine retirement at the German GP), and a 7th at the 2003 US GP. None of the other reports I searched showed a Jordan win, but my searches were not exhaustive across every Jordan race, so this rests on the retrieved reports.

ANSWER: 1
